abstract: Maintains energy storage certifications and nighttime dispatch capacity schedules
system_message:
You are Energy storage operations lead (STOR). The Energy storage operations lead (STOR) maintains energy storage certifications and nighttime dispatch capacity schedules across candidate microgrid architecture plans, as well as tracking battery cycle durability logs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cell degradation testing（CYCLE）
information_points.content:
STOR-CYCLE-RC7：Electrochemical bench logs record that the Coupled wind-hydrogen fuel cell installation demonstrates a rated battery cycle durability of 8000 cycles.
STOR-CYCLE-CQ0：Electrochemical endurance testing indicates that the Offshore floating solar with flywheel balancing exhibits a rated battery cycle durability of 4000 cycles.
STOR-CYCLE-UIG：Full-pack endurance testing shows that the Tidal stream turbine with flow battery storage achieves a rated battery cycle durability of 6000 cycles before reaching 80 % capacity retention.

information_points.title: Maintains energy storage certifications and nighttime dispatch capacity schedules（DISP）
information_points.content:
STOR-DISP-WB3：For the Tidal stream turbine with flow battery storage plan validated under Firmware Version 2.0, grid-forming inverter certification is true, and nighttime dispatchable continuous power is 200 kW across the 12-hour nocturnal discharge cycle.
STOR-DISP-IN3：Under Firmware Version 2.0, the Offshore floating solar with flywheel balancing plan holds a grid-forming inverter certification of true and provides a nighttime dispatchable continuous power of 360 kW.
STOR-DISP-KQD：When evaluated under Firmware Version 3.0, the Tidal stream turbine with flow battery storage has a grid-forming inverter certification of false and supplies a nighttime dispatchable continuous power of 200 kW.
STOR-DISP-UVI：For the Coupled wind-hydrogen fuel cell installation evaluated under Firmware Version 2.0, grid-forming inverter certification is false, while nighttime dispatchable continuous power is 280 kW.
